manually_inspected_differences.evidence: With God uses 'I firmly believe all the sacred truths ... because Thou hast revealed them'; Young Man's Guide reads 'as Thou hast revealed them to her, I believe ...'. Full-form facsimile check pending.
The books use 'omnipotent' and 'all-powerful' respectively. Do not create two user-facing tabs solely for this.
With God 'I wish to consecrate'; Young Man's Guide 'I wish and I resolve to consecrate'.
Evening formula includes a firmer resolution with help of grace; the morning formula asks to avoid occasions and do God's will. Do not collapse morning and evening versions by title alone.

Blessed Be God explicitly mentions 'reparation for my sins' and 'intention of the Apostleship of Prayer'; With God specifies monthly papal intention and associates. Canonical modern Morning Offering mentions joys/sufferings, reunion of Christians: not identical 1925 words.
With God has explicit Night Prayer by St Alphonsus; The Young Man's Guide Daily Prayers portion has no such headed night prayer. No YMG entry should be fabricated.
Both print the nocturnal collect beginning 'Visit, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this habitation'. Original page comparison needed before exact-match certificate.

publication_guard: NO exact-text variants released. These are family-identity matches, not complete word-for-word collation or licence determination.
